query:
-- HE Encens - Boswellia
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Boswellia%' OR name LIKE '%Encens%' OR name LIKE '%Oliban%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-009' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Myrrhe - Commiphora
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Commiphora%' OR name LIKE '%Myrrhe%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-010' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Galbanum - Ferula
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Ferula%' OR name LIKE '%Galbanum%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-011' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Immortelle - Helichrysum
UPDATE raw_materials rm

WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-012' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Camomille Romaine - Chamaemelum

SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Chamaemelum%' OR name LIKE '%Camomille%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-013' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Camomille Bleue - Matricaria
UPDATE raw_materials rm

-- HE Cardamome - Elettaria

SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Elettaria%' OR name LIKE '%Cardamome%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-015' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;
